title: Pokémon Bulk cards
description:
All items are in excellent condition and have been individually sleeved. Pricing is based on Collectr market values, and I am open to reasonable offers.

I have recently added two duplicate cards from the 30th Anniversary collection to the inventory.

Please note that the folder is not included; however, all items will be securely packaged in a box with bubble wrap, and select cards will be provided in top loaders. I am available to address any inquiries.
